description: This file is a bash shell script used for managing external toolchain tasks in a build environment, including testing compiler features, finding libraries, creating wrappers for compiler binaries, and generating configuration files for cross-compilation targets.

methods.name: test_c
methods.description: Tests C compiler support by compiling a simple 'Hello, world!' program.

methods.name: test_cxx
methods.description: Tests C++ compiler support by compiling a simple 'Hello, world!' program.

methods.name: test_softfloat
methods.description: Checks support for soft floating-point operations in the compiler.

methods.name: test_uclibc
methods.description: Detects if uClibc is used by checking for specific shared library files.

methods.name: test_feature
methods.description: Performs various feature tests (like 'c', 'c++', 'softfloat', and uClibc features) in the toolchain.

methods.name: find_libs
methods.description: Finds shared libraries matching a specified pattern based on the library specifications.

methods.name: find_bins
methods.description: Finds binary executables matching a specified pattern based on the binary specifications.

methods.name: find_gcc_version
methods.description: Detects the version of GCC in the toolchain.

methods.name: wrap_bin_cc
methods.description: Creates a wrapper script for the C compiler.

methods.name: wrap_bin_ld
methods.description: Creates a wrapper script for the linker.

methods.name: wrap_bin_other
methods.description: Creates a generic wrapper script for other binaries.

methods.name: wrap_bins
methods.description: Wraps all compiler, linker, and related binaries in a specified directory.

methods.name: print_config
methods.description: Generates a configuration file (.config) for the specified target by analyzing the toolchain.

methods.name: probe_cc
methods.description: Probes and finds the C compiler in the toolchain.

methods.name: probe_cxx
methods.description: Probes and finds the C++ compiler in the toolchain.

methods.name: probe_cpp
methods.description: Probes and finds the C preprocessor in the toolchain.

methods.name: probe_libc
methods.description: Detects the C library type (uClibc or glibc) used in the toolchain.
